# Raspberry Pi 4 firmware settings for rpi-Digital-TRX
start_file=start4.elf
fixup_file=fixup4.dat
kernel=Image
arm_64bit=1
disable_overscan=1
gpu_mem_1024=64

# The AMBE board (DV3000) uses the main serial port, /dev/ttyAMA0 on GPIO 14/15.
# Move Bluetooth off it, and keep the console off it (see cmdline.txt).
enable_uart=1
dtoverlay=disable-bt

# The LCD plate is on I2C bus 1 (GPIO 2/3).
dtparam=i2c_arm=on

# Onboard audio stays on; the app uses the USB headset.
dtparam=audio=on
